instruction.text: Turn left from the place you are standing you will find an open door. Now exit from the room. Now slightly turn left and go straight. Now you are in front of the window. Now turn back and keep moving forward until you reach the open door in front of you. Now go straight and turn left. You will find an open door. Now enter into the open door. Now slightly turn right and go straight. Now you are in front of the oven. Now slightly turn left and go straight. Now stand in front of the stove. That will be your final destination.
